programs.title: Gumrah
programs.desc: Meena, who lives with her retired and widowed father in rural Nainital, is visited by her sister, her husband and her two children. Meena speaks of her love for Rajendra, a painter and singer, and Kamla, her sister, approves of her choice. However, before Meena can make a move, Kamla passes away leaving her children in the hands of Meena.

programs.title: Ek Hi Raasta
programs.desc: Amar and Malti, two orphans, lead a harmonious life with their son, Raja. However, Amar gets murdered and circumstances force Malti to marry Amar's boss, Prakash, which is not accepted by Raja

programs.title: Ittefaq
programs.desc: Dilip Roy is a painter by trade and, despite possessing a beautiful wife called Sushma, he spends most of his time painting. On the day of their anniversary celebration, Dilip is late finishing a painting when a frustrated Sushma snatches the brush from his hand. Furious, Dilip strangles her to death, is arrested and sent to a psychiatric institute.
